_comment: FICTIONAL fixture. Defects planted in static/css/index.css and static/js/index.js only; index.html is unchanged. evals/check_fixtures.py checks that the audit reports each audit_id (run in CI); eval 16 (Polish) is graded against the fixes. Keep outside any agent's working folder.

defects.defect: index.js injects a fixed 56 px lab bar at the top of the screen and pads the body, so every Contents jump lands its heading under the bar
defects.fix: Remove the injected bar, or add html { scroll-padding-top } equal to its height

defects.defect: index.css folds the abstract into a box with max-height: 7.5rem and overflow: hidden, so most of it is cut off
defects.fix: Remove the max-height and overflow rule

defects.defect: index.css's :focus-visible rule sets outline: none instead of the focus ring, so keyboard users cannot see where they are
defects.fix: Restore outline: var(--focus-ring) in that rule

defects.defect: index.css sets the author names to 11px
index.css sets the title to white-space: nowrap, so on a phone it runs off the screen and the page scrolls sideways
index.js advances the carousel every 4 seconds by clicking Next, also for visitors who prefer reduced motion
defects.fix: Remove the timer, or use the template's data-autoplay option, which respects the preference

defects.defect: index.js pulses the venue pill with an endless Web Animations API animation, which the template's reduced-motion CSS cannot stop
defects.fix: Remove the animation, or start it only when prefers-reduced-motion is not set

defects.defect: index.css gives the Results container margin-left: 3rem, so the section sits off-centre
index.js hides Limitations until a scroll-reveal runs, and the reveal is skipped under reduced motion, so those visitors never see the limitations
defects.fix: Show the section by default and fade it only under prefers-reduced-motion: no-preference, or remove the reveal

defects.defect: index.css lightens figure captions to #a3acb9, below 4.5:1 contrast on white
defects.fix: Restore the caption colour token (or any colour with at least 4.5:1)

defects.defect: index.css squashes the teaser video to height: 220px with object-fit: fill, so the ripple fields are distorted
defects.fix: Remove the height and object-fit override so the video keeps its 960x360 aspect

defects.defect: index.css turns the Results figures grey (filter: grayscale(1)), so the colour-coded methods in the panels can no longer be told apart
